definition: The group of words for the kinds of figure a kit parameter may be, told apart by where the figure came from: measured, derived, editorial, invented, or imposed by a building code.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`param-kind` holds the kinds of figure a kit parameter may be, by where the figure came from", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
